newsitem.title: UK: Menvier Swain up on positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: Menvier Swain up on positive press comment.

text.p: Shares in electrical company Menvier Swain Group Plc climbed on Monday after the Sunday Times newspaper said the stock looked undervalued, dealers said.
Menvier shares rose 6p to 227-1/2p by 0925 GMT in thin volume of 4,000 shares.
The newspaper said the shares had recently been dogged by poor sentiment towards the electronics and electricals equipment sector and weak trading results by competitors.
However, the Sunday Times expected Menvier to report full year pre-tax profits in excess of 15 million stg this week and said the shares looked cheap at 220p.
A spokeswoman at Menvier said the company would report full year results on July 22.
